_comment: qou as a platform LAYER (owner ruling 2026-11-24, "1 qou is platform later"), laid out as the dth-hrh folio is: the layers it runs on are mounted at the repository root from index.lock.json (gitignored), and the site is built by cat-harness-tools' build-instance-site.ts from the recipe under site.build. The `folio-assistant/` platform link (scripts/setup-folio-assistant.sh, .folio-assistant-pin) is kept as a COMPATIBILITY path for the hooks and scripts that still name it; each moves to the root mounts on its own. The qou entry overlays qou.config.json, which the compatibility path still reads.

instances.name: qou
instances._site_comment: The recipe (cat-harness-tools build-instance-site.ts): site:document writes the Documents landing and one interactive page per paper at en/<slug>/ (folio-assistant-core build-document-site.ts; qou, ugb, fred2005, bach2013). The site steps run on the built site: the LaTeX PDF as each paper's export (en/<slug>/export/<slug>-latest.pdf), the accuracy scorecard (/accuracy/), the work plan (/beans/), the integrated QA panel (/qa/), the Lean library render (/lean/: the stored render for now; owner ruling 2026-11-24 "2 verso" moves it to the Verso tool, so it is one declared slot, scripts/site-step.sh lean), the /papers/<slug>/ redirects, and CONTRIBUTING and LICENSE. coverage is `report` because the work plan and QA writers ship in cat-harness-tools#2511/#2512, not yet on the pinned platform; flip it to `refuse` once they are.
